title: Fearless Public Surface Deepening
problem: Several post-FCAB facade and runtime Modules still expose shallow wildcard surfaces or large mixed-purpose implementation files that reduce locality and make future public-surface changes harder to review.
objective: Deepen public facade and core runtime Modules by replacing shallow wildcard mirrors with explicit surfaces, splitting large implementation files behind stable roots, and auditing remaining compatibility shims.
gates: cargo nextest run -p siumai --test tooling_runtime_public_surface_test public_surface_tooling_runtime_contract_compiles --no-default-features --features openai --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p siumai --test public_surface_imports_test public_surface_tooling_imports_compile --no-default-features --features openai --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: Continue while slices preserve public paths and have focused gates. Split a child lane for compatibility removals or deep streaming behavior changes.
